notebooks.title: Sensor readings to a daily average

cells.source:
# Sensor readings to a daily average

Grain of bronze: one row per sensor and reading time. Grain of silver: one row per sensor and day.

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE bronze.sensor_readings AS
SELECT * FROM (VALUES
  ('s1', TIMESTAMP '2026-10-01 08:00:00', 21.5),
  ('s1', TIMESTAMP '2026-10-01 14:00:00', 23.0),
  ('s2', TIMESTAMP '2026-10-01 08:00:00', 19.0),
  ('s2', TIMESTAMP '2026-10-02 08:00:00', 18.5)
) AS t(sensor_id, read_at, temp_c);

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver.sensor_daily AS
SELECT sensor_id, CAST(read_at AS DATE) AS day, avg(temp_c) AS avg_temp_c, count(*) AS readings
FROM bronze.sensor_readings
GROUP BY ALL;

-- Days with a single reading: an average of one value hides gaps.
SELECT * FROM silver.sensor_daily WHERE readings < 2 ORDER BY sensor_id, day;
